activity_summary: After breakfast you went up and did not open the tables at once. They lay shut on the bed. The stylus was in the gutter. You sat with the cover down.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Waited with the cover down, then wrote the three words and stopped.

entities.name: the writing-tables
entities.context: Mentioned in Went up and sat with the tables shut

facets.activity: Wrote three words for the morning
